# Abstract

In this paper, we propose methods for the estimation of parameters for the three-parameter Reflected Weibull (RW) distribution. The Moment estimator (MME), Maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) and Location and Scale Parameters free maximum likelihood estimator (LSPFE). The LSPFE is based on a data transformation, which avoids the problem of unbounded likelihood estimator. Through Mont Carlo simulations, we further show that the LSPFE performs better than MME and MLE in terms of bias and root mean squared error (RMSE). Finally, two examples based on real data sets are presented to illustrate methods.
Keyword: Reflected Weibull, Mont Carlo simulations, Moment estimator, Maximum likelihood estimator.
